title: The Same Boat
logline: A fisherman's boat has been repaired so many times that no original plank is left, but everyone still calls it by the same name.

object.note: Object 1 (identity not chosen) may appear subtly, for example among Chathura's things while he travels, waits or watches, only where it sits naturally in a real moment. Never staged, never the subject.

thread_in.thread: The question left by the novices' memorised map, a name for everything inside, meets an outside mirror: a boat still called by one name though its planks have all been replaced.

thread_out.thread: From the salt water the boat works on to the fresh water a village waits for: after a thing that stays 'the same' while every part changes, a thing that is named though it is only empty space.
